known_open_defects.status: open in released 1.0.4; separate fix in progress; not fixed by this checkpoint
known_open_defects.summary: Permission-helper restart can exit Itda without the transfer admission/quit guard and interrupt active copies.
known_open_defects.source_evidence: permission_restart calls restart_app directly. advance uses a non-atomic busy snapshot before restart_app, without closing transfer admissions. restart_app schedules the relaunch then calls super::quit; its final Wake::Quit exits the event loop without the guarded request_quit path.
known_open_defects.verification_scope: source-confirmed; native reproduction and actual transfer consequences unverified; no new permission/native action was performed by this checkpoint

known_open_defects.status: open in released 1.0.4; separate fix in progress; not fixed by this checkpoint
known_open_defects.summary: The permission guide reset button emits guide_reset, but its native IPC allowlist excludes that command, making the reset handler unreachable from the UI.
known_open_defects.source_evidence: The guide UI sends guide_reset and a native handler exists, but the guide IPC forwarding allowlist admits only guide_ready, guide_reveal and guide_copy. The UI command therefore never reaches the reset handler.
known_open_defects.verification_scope: source-confirmed; native reset and TCC behavior unverified; no reset or permission change was performed

known_open_defects.status: open in released 1.0.4; separate follow-up fix in progress; not fixed by this checkpoint
known_open_defects.summary: A stale transfer-wait Cancel control can reopen copy admissions after an update has already started.
known_open_defects.source_evidence: Deterministic sequence from independent source review168: request Update during a transfer, choose Wait, then let the transfer finish. go_now(Update) clears the pending quit without removing the cancel bar. Clicking its stale Cancel calls quit_choice(cancel), which reopens admissions while UPDATING remains true. A newly admitted copy can then be interrupted by the update worker final quit.
known_open_defects.verification_scope: source-confirmed deterministic control-flow sequence; actual updater, stale-Cancel UI interaction and transfer interruption were not executed or natively verified

known_open_defects.status: open in released 1.0.4; separate follow-up fix in progress; not fixed by this checkpoint
known_open_defects.summary: An idle Windows user quit during UPDATING can exit before the updater finishes its in-process executable rename/copy, leaving a partial installation.
known_open_defects.source_evidence: Independent source review168 confirms the Windows idle user-quit path can bypass waiting for update installation success while UPDATING is true. Exiting the process at that point can terminate its in-process installer during executable rename/copy.
known_open_defects.verification_scope: source-confirmed; no actual update, Windows quit-during-install or partial-install scenario was executed or natively verified
